description.value: Descanso Bay Regional Park is a Regional District of Nanaimo campground on Gabriola Island, reachable by ferry from Nanaimo. It sits along the sheltered shores of Descanso Bay and serves as a key overnight stop on the Vancouver Crossing Loop touring route. The park is managed by the RDN and represents one of the few formal camping options on Gabriola Island for cycle tourists.
